name: Data.toPoly_linePolyCoords
summary: Compare coefficients after evaluating the coefficient polynomials at every point.

steps.claim: Two polynomials with polynomial coefficients agree if every coefficient agrees at every point z (ext, funext); this is the first part of weylNormSq_linePolyCoords_le with φ = id (coefficient of d after evaluation at z).
steps.lean:
inFirstCols (stackedDetProd (posEquiv j) (detRows j i Y)) := MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun d ↦ funext
  fun z ↦ by
    simpa [← coeff_map] using! congr(($((weylNormSq_linePolyCoords_le j i Y 1 z).1)).coeff d)
